aiResearchSummary.text: Aramco Oil Pipelines is developing technologies for pipeline operations and integrity, including inspecting a pipeline with an unmanned aerial vehicle and online inspection and sensing of pipe joints. It also advances pipeline scale removal and an integrated pipeline pigs manufacturing and launching system for non metallic pigs. Together these efforts target leak detection, structural health monitoring, scale cleaning, and in situ pig fabrication and deployment along pipelines.
